script.body:
First Ppeok : Immediately earn the configured amount when making a Ppeok on your first turn.

Double Ppeok : Immediately earn 2x the configured amount when making another Ppeok on the second turn.

Triple Ppeok : Making a third consecutive Ppeok immediately awards 4x the configured amount and ends the game in victory.
Succeeding in a Ddadak on the first turn immediately awards an amount equivalent to 3 points during the game.
1 Go adds +1 pt, 2 Go adds +2 pts, 3+ Go adds +1 pt per Go and doubles (x2) for each Go from 3 Go onward (e.g., 5 Go = +5 pts and x8, 6 Go = +6 pts and x16).
Holding 3 cards of the same month allows you to reveal them (Shake) or place all 3 on a matching floor card (Bomb). Winning after Shake or Bomb doubles (x2) your score.
Scoring and calling Go after an opponent has already called Go. Stopping after a Counter Go doubles your score and can inflict Go-bak.
If no player reaches 3 points (7 in 2-player Matgo) by the last card, or a player who called Go fails to score an extra point, the round is declared Nagari and the next game is played at 2x score.
When the winner scores with 10+ Pi (junk) cards and a loser has 5 or fewer Pi cards. Doubles (x2) final score.
When the winner scores with 3+ Gwang (bright) cards and a loser has 0 Gwang cards. Doubles (x2) final score.
When the winner scores with Animal (10-pt) cards and a loser has 0 Animal cards. Doubles (x2) final score.
Winning with 7 or more Animal (10-pt) cards. Doubles (x2) final score.

When a player calls Go but another player reaches the target score and declares Stop.
2-player (Matgo): The Go-bak player pays 2x.
3+ players (Go-Stop): The Go-bak player pays on behalf of the other losers as well.
2 Brights + Rain Bright
+1 pt per extra card / Stacks with Godori

+1 pt per extra card
/ Stacks with Red, Blue, Grass Ribbons

+1 pt per extra card
/ Double Pi counts as 2, Triple Pi as 3
Winner scores at least 1 pt from Pi and opponent has 5 or fewer Pi cards.
Winner scores from Gwang and opponent has 0 Gwang cards.
A player calls Go, but another player reaches the target score and stops.
Winner scores from Animal cards and opponent has 0 Animal cards.
Winning after revealing 3 cards of the same month in hand.
Placing 3 cards of the same month from hand onto the 4th matching card on the floor.
Target score is 7 pts. Deal 8 cards to the floor and 10 cards to each player.
Target score is 3 pts. Deal 6 cards to the floor and 7 cards to each player.

Target score is 3 pts. Deal 6 cards to the floor and 7 cards to each player.
One player sells cards and sits out the round.

1. Determine the dealer (First player) by drawing cards.

2. Shuffle and deal cards counterclockwise.

3. On your turn, play a card from your hand to match a floor card of the same month, then flip the top card of the draw pile.

4. When a player reaches 3+ points (7+ in 2-player), they choose to call 'Go' (continue for higher points/multipliers) or 'Stop' (claim victory and settle scores).
